name: Doras
summary: Above Orgrimmar, Doras sends wind riders across Kalimdor. He oversees the capital's wyverns, carrying couriers, scouts, and travelers to distant places.

sections.title: Master of the Skyway
sections.body: Doras tends the wind riders on a wooden platform above the Valley of Strength. Since the Horde settled in Durotar, these clever, leathery-winged beasts have carried messages and travelers across Kalimdor. Doras pairs resting mounts with riders and sees that important messages and reinforcements reach distant outposts. Their routes lead to the Crossroads and Thunder Bluff, and to settlements deep in Ashenvale or Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: Doras waits atop the flight tower overlooking Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Follow the winding ramps up the central timber structures near the city entrance to reach his roost.
Doras manages wind riders, also called wyverns. Native to Kalimdor's arid crags and savannas, these intelligent, venomous winged predators befriended the Horde and carry riders over long distances.

aliases: where can i fly from orgrimmar
faq.answer: Doras sends travelers from Orgrimmar to Horde outposts across central and northern Kalimdor. Routes include the Crossroads in the Barrens, Thunder Bluff in Mulgore, and military camps in Ashenvale and beyond.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you can rely on Doras for swift flights from the capital to allied settlements across Kalimdor.
